summary: A mixed day driven by retail sector momentum and Reliance's major debt fundraising. Swiss Beauty Select targets ₹100 crore revenue with 100%+ growth, while Reliance lines up its second $1 billion bond sale in three weeks.

bullets.text: Reliance Industries plans up to $1 billion local currency bond sale, its second fundraise in three weeks.
Swiss Beauty Select projects over 100% growth, targeting ₹100 crore revenue by FY26-27.
J Infratech files IPO papers targeting ₹600 crore via fresh issue.
Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, S&R Associates, Hogan Lovells advise on Hero Motors ₹1,000 crore IPO.
Decathlon targets ₹1,000 crore running sports business revenue within 4 years, expanding northeast.
